Less than a week after releasing macOS 26.7.1 and macOS 15.8.1 RC 1, Apple is now rolling out the second release candidate as it prepares for an official launch. Here are the details.

macOS 26.7.1 and 15.8.1 Second RC Now Available for Download

Last week, Apple released the first release candidates for macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1. On the same day, the company also rolled out macOS 27.2 beta 1, rather than the macOS 27.1 beta 1 and its related versions that most users and developers had anticipated.

While macOS 27.2 beta 1 adds French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish support for Siri AI, the beta versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 are rather uneventful, with Apple only stating that they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users to install."

Apple is expected to announce the related security details when it officially releases macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 in the coming weeks.

The official build number for macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 RC 2 is 25G313, while the build number for the second RC of macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 is 24H212.

Have you discovered any new features in this RC build? Let us know in the comments.
